subject: Cross-region commitment shift & PO handoff — Solstice AI renewal

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Solstice renewal: cross-region commitment sequencing

Hi Liam —

Thanks again for the call today. Per our discussion, we'd like to align on two things so we can finalize paperwork this month:

1) How you want the commitment split surfaced on the purchase order (single PO that references both regions vs. two region-specific POs).
2) Preferred invoice cadence (single consolidated invoice vs. region-staggered invoices).

Attached is a draft PO for your review (PO-draft-solstice.pdf) and a short summary of the proposed commitment shift. If you can confirm the procurement contact or forward to them, we can map the billing flow and get a Private Offer queued in AWS Marketplace.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm PO format and procurement contact by 11/10
- We generate AWS Private Offer + DocuSign by 11/13 for signature
- Billing to begin on new term 12/01

Let me know if that timeline works.

Best,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Renewals, Redwood Inference
[rachel.kim@redwood.com]

Thanks Rachel —

Quick answers:
- Procurement prefers a single PO referencing both regions with a line-item breakdown by region (EU / US). They need the tax/VAT registration details on the PO.
- Invoices: they prefer a consolidated monthly invoice but are okay with region-tagged line items (their AP team uses a single ledger).

Procurement contact is: procurement@solstice.ai (cc'ing now). Can your PO include a short note about how burst capacity/overage will be billed? We had a brief question from finance about SLA credits if regional latency guarantees change after the split.

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: procurement@solstice.ai, Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@solstice.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T11:28:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Solstice renewal: cross-region commitment sequencing — PO and private offer options

Hi Liam / procurement team —

Looping in to outline the practical options and what we need to complete paperwork quickly. Summary below — attaching our AWS Private Offer template and a small tax evidence export (tax-evidence.csv).

Options (pros/cons):
- Single PO + AWS Private Offer (recommended): one PO referencing a single commitment with regional line-items. Private Offer in the console will reflect the committed USD amount and we can add a note showing EU split for internal reporting. This keeps AP on a single invoice cadence.
- Two region POs (less friction for some EU AP teams): requires two Private Offers or an internal mapping layer; increases paperwork and can delay acceptance.

Key asks from Redwood side:
- Confirm VAT/Tax ID and billing address for the EU entity (we included tax-evidence.csv for formats)
- Confirm whether Solstice wants burst capacity billed as usage over commitment (default) or as a pre-purchased overage buffer (requires amendment).

SLA notes: our standard Marketplace SLA applies; we can include language on regional latency SLOs but SLA credits and exceptions are handled via the renewal amendment. If you want a hard SLA uplift for the EU region, legal will need to review and that's usually a 48–72 hour turnaround for a redline.

Attachments: aws-private-offer-template.docx, tax-evidence.csv

If procurement confirms single PO + consolidated invoice, we'll draft the Private Offer and route it through your procurement contact for acceptance.

-Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Marketplace & Renewals Operations, Redwood Inference

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@solstice.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:45:00-00:00
Subject: Re: Solstice renewal: cross-region commitment sequencing — PO and private offer options

Kimberly —

Thanks, that all looks good. Procurement confirms: single PO with EU VAT ID is best. I attached our VAT registration (forwarded). For burst billing we prefer usage-overage billing (no pre-purchase).

Regarding SLA: we are not requesting a formal uplift right now, but we do want the Private Offer to call out the regional deployment plan and include a contact for escalation if latency jumps after go-live. That should be sufficient for our legal/ops reviewers.

Procurement contact (official): procurement@solstice.ai
